newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index falls 9.3 points to 913.9. [corrected 15:55 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index falls 9.3 points to 913.9. [corrected 15:55 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects index value in headline to 913.9 from 933.9)
The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 9.3 points on Friday to 913.9, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Losses across the board pulled all ten sectoral indices down, with the finance sector index losing the most, down 20.2 points to 1,218.4.
